newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kissei shares up on news of HIV drug trial.
newsitem.headline: Kissei shares up on news of HIV drug trial.

text.p: Shares of Kissei Pharmaceutical Co Ltd jumped in early afternoon trade on Friday after the company said that the Aids Clinial Trial Group of the United States would start phase two clinical trials of an HIV drug, paving the way for Kissei's development of the drug in Japan.
As of 0418 GMT, the share price was up 60 yen to trade at 2,980. It briefly rose to 3,000. Volume was 353,000 shares.

Kissei will wait for the result of the phase two clinical trial in the United States, which is expected to start in October and be completed at the end of 1997, before deciding to go on with its clinical trials in Japan, a company spokesman said.
